CALCULATIONS USING NUMBER OF MOLES

OPTION 1:
| | $\text{N}_2\text{O}_4$ | $\text{NO}_2$ |
|---|---|---|
| Initial amount (moles) | X | 0 |
| Change in amount (moles) | $-0{,}2X$ $\checkmark$ | $+0{,}4X$ (ratio 1:2 $\checkmark$) |
| Equilibrium amount (moles) | $0{,}8X$ | $0{,}4X$ |
| Equilibrium concentration ($\text{mol}\cdot\text{dm}^{-3}$) | $0{,}4X$ | $0{,}2X$ (divide by $2\text{ dm}^3$ $\checkmark$) |

$$K_c = \frac{[\text{NO}_2]^2}{[\text{N}_2\text{O}_4]} \quad \checkmark$$
$$0{,}16 \quad \checkmark = \frac{(0{,}2X)^2}{0{,}4X} \quad \checkmark$$
$$0{,}16 = \frac{0{,}04X^2}{0{,}4X} = 0{,}1X$$
$$X = 1{,}6\text{ mol} \quad \checkmark$$

OPTION 2:
$$\Delta n(\text{N}_2\text{O}_4) = \frac{20}{100}X = 0{,}2X \quad \checkmark$$
$$\Delta n(\text{NO}_2) = 2\Delta n(\text{N}_2\text{O}_4) = 0{,}4X \quad \checkmark$$
$$n(\text{N}_2\text{O}_4)_{\text{eq}} = X - 0{,}2X = 0{,}8X \quad \text{and} \quad n(\text{NO}_2)_{\text{eq}} = 0 + 0{,}4X \quad \checkmark$$
$$c(\text{N}_2\text{O}_4)_{\text{eq}} = \frac{0{,}8X}{2} = 0{,}4X \quad \text{and} \quad c(\text{NO}_2)_{\text{eq}} = \frac{0{,}4X}{2} = 0{,}2X \quad (\text{divide by } 2\text{ dm}^3 \checkmark)$$
$$K_c = \frac{[\text{NO}_2]^2}{[\text{N}_2\text{O}_4]} \quad \checkmark$$
$$0{,}16 \quad \checkmark = \frac{(0{,}2X)^2}{0{,}4X} \quad \checkmark$$
$$X = 1{,}6\text{ mol} \quad \checkmark$$

OPTION 3 (Using concentration):
Initial concentration $c(\text{N}_2\text{O}_4) = \frac{X}{2} = 0{,}5X$
$$\Delta c(\text{N}_2\text{O}_4) = 0{,}2(0{,}5X) = 0{,}1X \quad \checkmark$$

$$K_c = \frac{[\text{NO}_2]^2}{[\text{N}_2\text{O}_4]} \quad \checkmark$$
$$0{,}16 \quad \checkmark = \frac{(0{,}2X)^2}{0{,}4X} \quad \checkmark$$
$$X = 1{,}6\text{ mol} \quad \checkmark$$
